zoe-partners: Quick standup: Datadog partner wants a concise "observability playbook" for GPU inference (traces, dashboard, marketplace tile). Need to confirm fields, demo timeline, and who provides assets.
omar-obs: I'll own dashboard + demo script. Main ask: show model-level latencies, KV cache hits, and a fallback routing marker. Keep visuals stable (30s rolling avg).

lee-datadog: We can auto-tag using collector rules. Recommend fields: resource.attributes.model_name, resource.attributes.model_version, redwood.customer_tier, span.duration_ms. Small collector snippet below maps to datadog tags: 
```yaml
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: resource.attributes.model_name
        action: upsert
        new_key: dd.tag.model_name
      - key: redwood.customer_tier
        action: upsert
        new_key: dd.tag.customer_tier
```

maria-marketing: Timeline: need raw recording by Thu so we can produce a 30s social cut. Also need two screenshots: dashboard overview + trace waterfall.

legal-bot: Reminder: co-branded language and quotes need approval. Submit drafts early.

omar-obs: CI queued demo env after pushing dashboard JSON. Will attach runbook: `./demo/run.sh --models v2,v2-quant --simulate-fallback`.

ci-bot: CI job started: integrations/marketplace-demo #6123. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/integrations/6123/artifacts

zoe-partners: Recap: Omar dashboard + runbook (due Wed), Lee collector snippet + assets (today), Maria editing (Thu), Legal review (in flight). Hold public posts until we have sign-off from Datadog and legal.

omar-obs: Will post dashboard JSON and short recording link here when CI finishes.
